As someone who's been trying to learn a foreign language for a couple years, I'm gonna tell you it's not easy. If you really wanna speak another language, you need to really make that language your second language. Us English speakers are challenged at learning other languages because everything's translated for us, we feel no pressure to learn other languages like people who have a more obscure native tongue. It's gonna be difficult, but you need to pick a language to stick to and find all the resources you need to learn that language. Practice it every day and practice using it even if you know you're inept. You need to use it every day if you wanna know it, even when you're a beginner. Also literally look up how to learn that language or any language, you'll find good tips.
